$comment: How the Play listing's graphics are laid out; their words are each language's store/text/<locale>/captions.json, keyed by `shot`. Order = order on the store page (Play shows up to 8). `shot` names a raw capture from StoreScreenshots (spares: schedule-day, student, schedule-week, schedule-month, group, settings, settings-calendar, reports-dark); `kind: lockscreen` draws the notifications it recorded instead, `kind: homescreen` the widgets on a home screen; `theme` picks the backdrop. Titles break at \n. The promo video (video.mjs) reuses the captions — and shows `filmOnly`'s, which are not stills — the tagline and `cta`; a caption's `film` is its wording in the video instead, where the video shows more than the still. See docs/store-listing.md.
